stockfish.js 19.0.1
===================

ChessFEN vendors the pinned lite single-threaded and lite multithreaded
browser engines from the stockfish.js project, a WebAssembly build of
Stockfish 19.

Upstream project:
https://github.com/nmrugg/stockfish.js

Release:
https://github.com/nmrugg/stockfish.js/releases/tag/v19.0.1

Distribution:
npm package stockfish@19.0.1, tarball shasum
c557a1b9f075a67f38e01332c6db7472d8df744e

Vendored on 2026-11-25; lite multithreaded assets added 2026-11-26:
